hrg_optimization_structure.description: Automaton and generated-model compactness for HRG games after the paper's optimizer and rg2cpp compiler pipeline. The paper reports mean HRG optimization reductions of 47% fewer nodes and 41% fewer edges; fixed playout completion is a correctness constraint for the generated reasoner.

automaton_node_reduction_pct.description: Percentage reduction in optimized automaton nodes versus the same HRG input compiled without optimizer passes.

automaton_edge_reduction_pct.description: Percentage reduction in optimized automaton edges versus the same HRG input compiled without optimizer passes.

generated_cpp_line_reduction_pct.description: Percentage reduction in generated C++ source lines versus the same HRG input compiled without optimizer passes.

playout_completion_rate.description: Fraction of selected generated reasoners that complete deterministic fixed-count playouts without pipeline errors.

table1_playout_throughput_subset.description: Section 4 / Table 1 matched HRG and RBG source-language benchmark on a subset of games. The paper reports playout throughput; this gym keeps throughput as supporting context but scores machine-independent generated-code and automaton-size advantages to avoid hardware-dependent ranking.

generated_cpp_line_advantage_vs_rbg_pct.description: Mean percentage by which generated HRG-derived C++ source is shorter than the matched RBG-derived generated source for the same games.

automaton_edge_advantage_vs_rbg_pct.description: Mean percentage by which optimized HRG-derived automata have fewer edges than matched RBG-derived automata for the same games.

speedup_vs_rbg_rg.description: Within-job HRG/RBG playout-throughput ratio retained only as diagnostic context because wall-clock throughput is hardware-sensitive.

sims_per_second.description: Raw simulation throughput retained only for diagnostics and not used for scoring.

states_per_second.description: Raw state-throughput retained only for diagnostics and not used for scoring.

benchmark_completion_rate.description: Fraction of selected generated reasoners that complete benchmark-mode playout work without pipeline errors.

games_completed.description: Number of selected matched games with positive completed benchmark work, retained only as diagnostic context because train and test slices contain different game counts.
